That the Contractor shall pay and continue to pay Minimum Wages to the workers and if it is found th at less wages were paid, contract will be terminated forthwith and the deficient wages will be deducte d by the Buyer from tenderer and paid directly to the workers employed by them and further, paymen t to the firm will be made only on satisfactory performance of work for each period as certified by the User and HR Department. 15. SCOPE OF WORK A. SCOPE & SPECIFICATIONS: The following provisions have been considered while framing of scope of work f or hiring of manpower for civil repair and maintenance work. a. Repairing of plaster (External and Internal) b. RCC work, Brick work Flooring and Tile work c. Internal and external painting of buildings. d. Water Supply: attending leakage of supply line, providing new pipe line, chan ge of damaged pipe line etc. e. Fixing of WC seat, wash basin, sink, replacing damaged & providing New PVC rain water pipes and sewer line works. f. Arresting leakages from water supply line, Supply and fixing of water supply fi ttings, bib cock, drainage pipes nipples, pipes, mirror cement bricks aggregate door windows fittings, lead for pipe jointing etc. g. The contracts will include various items related to civil and allied works, Day- to-day repair, maintenance at all heights and levels and miscellaneous works de pending on the job to be carried out. h. Shop drawings for fabrication work and any other works shall be prepared & s ubmitted by contractor to the SPM representative as per the requirement of SP M for approval. i. The successful bidder should attend the complaints after receiving requireme nt from SPM Authority. j. Bidder has to ensure required minimum 1 mason, 1 carpenter, 2 plumber and 4 helpers excluding Off-Reliever (OR) and Leave-Reliever (LR) for day-to-day civ il maintenance activity throughout the year (365 days). Alternate Persons shall be deployed in case of leave or weekly-off. k. The contractor shall engage a Site engineer (Civil Engineer having BE/Diplom a in Civil with 2/ 3 years’ construction and maintenance experience respectively ) who is capable of managing and guiding the work and understanding the speci fications and contract conditions. Site engineer will prepare estimates as per D SR and put up for approval to SPM officials. After completion of work actual mea surement should be recorded in the specified format. This Site engineer shall n ot be changed without prior intimation. The Engineer-in-charge has the right to ask for changes in case of miss behavior, work not perform satisfactory etc. to a ny of such staff. The contractor shall comply with such order and effect replace ments of the satisfaction of the Engineer-in-charge. At least one among Site Eng ineer and Store keeper should be present each day throughout the period of co ntract.

l. A qualified store keeper cum complaint writer (having B. Sc /B. Com with 2 ye ars’ experience) shall be provided by contractor for registering complaints, man power deputation at complaint receiving office and material management of sto re. At least one among Site Engineer and Store keeper should be present each day throughout the period of contract. m. Supply of skilled workers like welder, painter and unskilled workers for day-t o-day repair and maintenance work as and when required. n. The contractor should ensure the complete site clearance on each day during the progress of the work and also after the completion of the work by removing of debris/ Malba. o. Quantity of work: SPM authority reserve the full rights to increase or decreas e the quantities of item at the time of award tender and any time during executi on of contract period or extended period of contract. p. Records: - The Firm shall maintain complete official records like material brou ght at site register, site order book, attendance register, measurement book, ce ment register, test register, hindrance register, complaint register, workers note book, and any other records/documents to be required during execution of work etc.. SPM have rights to see these records any time and firm shall submit all rec ords as mentioned in this point to SPM as and when required. These documents shall be signed daily by the contractor or his representative and representative of SPM. q. Time Period: Three years after 15 days from award of NAC/Purchase order. r. T & P: Shall be arranged by contractor if required. s. Payment Terms and condition: -Firm should submit the monthly bill (along wit h documents related to statutory compliances such as ESI, PF and other clearan ces as applicable if any by state/central govt. regulatory bodies) before 10th d ay of next month after completion of calendar month. t. If successful bidder fails to provide required manpower, the payment of Rs.10 0/- per day per absence shall be deducted from bill (applicable on Mason, Plum ber, Carpenter and helper") B. Safety Conditions: a. Security Paper Mill Narmadapuram is a security organization have been decla red as PROTECTED AREA by the Govt. of India. Hence the bidder shall have to a bide by the prevailing security Norms. Any of the bidder‘s employee/works man /worker deployed at site found by the Company as having doubtful integrity, sh all be removed from the premises at the risk and cost. b. It shall be the sole responsibility of the contractor to ensure safety to all his w orkers. c. The contractor shall take all the precaution during the repainting/rework agai nst any type of personnel injury or any damage to the property, which can arise during working.

d. Bidder shall adhere to safety instructions as per SPM norms and special term s and conditions of contract. Adequate safety gadgets shall be provided by the contractor to the workmen as per norms. Adequate safety gadgets shall be prov ided by the contractor to the workmen as per norms and all PPEs issued by the bidder to their employees should be as per standard. e. The bidder shall arrange at their own cost for the personal protective equipm ent to the personnel engaged by them such as safety helmets, safety goggles, h and gloves, safety shoes, gumboots, PVC apron sand any other PPE required as per SPM safety guidelines. f. The contractor shall take all the precaution during execution of work against any hazards, personnel injury or any damage to the property. The contractor sh all provide adequate safety gadgets to the workmen as per norms. g. Bidder has to follow plant safety rules, security rules & labour acts etc.as appl icable and amended time to time. Plant safety rules and policy of the company f ramed as per MP Factories rules 1962 and Factories act 1948 are to be complie d by deputed contract employees. h. Precautions as stated in the safety clause are the minimum necessary and sh all not preclude the Contractor taking additional safety precautions as may be w arranted for the particular type of work or situations. Also, mere observance of t hese precautions shall not absolve the contractor of his liability in case of loss o r damage to property or injury to any person including the contractor ‘s worker, the SPM representatives or any member of the public or resulting in the death o f any of these. i. The Contractor will be required to take ― Workmen ‘s Compensation Insuranc e policy to all of his workmen engaged for the said job and copy of the same to be submitted. j. The Chief General Manager reserves the right to terminate the contract and fo rfeit any or all amounts due to him in case it is found that the precautions writte n on the permit and plant safety rules are not strictly adhered by the bidder. C. Other Terms and Conditions a. Water – The Contractor is permitted to avail the services available at site free of charge. b. Electricity – The Contractor is permitted to avail electricity at site free of char ge for performance of their scope of work. c. The Bidder has to pay to its employees not less than the minimum mandatory rates per month in accordance with the Minimum Wages. d. The Bidder shall be fully responsible for payment of (not less than minimum wages), P.F. contributions or any other benefits under various Labour Laws/Acts applicable to him and or the personnel employed by him. e. The Bidder shall comply with all Labour laws and other laws/statutory regulati ons applicable to it and/or the personnel to be employed by it but not limited to

the Minimum Wages Act, Contract Labour. f. (Regulation and Abolition) Act, Payment of Wages Act, Employees Provident F und and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952, ESI Act etc. from time to time and t ake such steps as may be deemed necessary in this regard. Further, after repea lment of the old laws and effect is given to the new 04 Labour Codes, the same are applicable. g. The Bidder shall get the antecedent of its personnel verified by the Police and the certificate to that effect should be submitted before their deployment at the SPM. Deployment/continuation of manpower is subjected to satisfactory police verification of individual. h. The Bidder shall also submit the names, present and permanent residential a ddresses and two copies of their passport size photographs to SPM. i. The Bidder shall hold Contract Labour License as per the Contract Labour Act, 1970. j. The contractor shall take instructions from the Engineer-in-charge regarding c ollection and stacking of materials in any place. k. The bidder at his own cost shall provide at least two set of uniform (Paint +Sh irt + safety shoes/gum boots) per annum to their personnel. No personnel shall be allowed to work without their uniform and safety shoes/gum boots.
